summary: Boost, shift and diagnostic dashboards drawn by the iDrive 6 head unit
author: wujiaming109
description:
BoostDeck, ShiftDeck, EngineCodes and MhdMaps as iDrive plugin apps: a boost and vacuum gauge deck, a gear and shift-light deck, a fault-code reader, and MHD map-slot control, all drawn by the head unit's own HMI in the My Vehicle menu.

The plugin folders and their QNX programs are the prebuilt binaries of the dashboard package in https://github.com/inotbarnacle/ID6_apps_prerelease at the commit this version names, unchanged. This package adds only the NBTApps manifest.json, the declared file modes, and one gateway-ip.txt per app.

Each app reaches the car through its own connection, so each needs the car's diagnostic gateway address in its own gateway-ip.txt, in the app's folder under ${plugins}. The archive ships 192.0.2.1, an RFC 5737 documentation address, so no app reaches anything until that file is set and the package rebuilt as a new version. The four apps talk to the DME, EGS and DSC over HSFZ, with MOST as the fallback, and read and clear fault codes; MhdMaps writes map slots, drives the exhaust flap and runs max cooling; xDrive Control switches AWD and RWD and requires the engine to be off. The programs were built for one reference firmware and framework combination, so on a car with another firmware they may not match.

Installs into ${plugins} and asks for an HMI restart. Connector ids 100, 102, 103 and 104 (Etch); the manifests declare no focus id. Not built or rebuilt by the NBTApps project, and not reviewed by the upstream author.
